prompts.spellguard: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one transparent painted game talent icon for Spellguard in Grimhollow, an original dark gothic dungeon game. A sturdy dark steel cuirass protected by a close-fitting arcane blue-violet ward, three pale hostile magical sparks visibly deflected off the ward. Distinct compact silhouette, painterly realistic metal and restrained brass trim, dramatic directional light, readable at 64 pixels. Single centered object, front three-quarter view, generous clear margin, no square frame, no scenery, no writing, letters, numbers or watermark. Real transparent background. Crisp edges and strong material separation; no pixel art. Output square.
prompts.journal: Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted interface atlas for Grimhollow, an original dark gothic dungeon game. EXACT 4 by 4 grid, sixteen independent centered cutout icons on true transparent alpha, equal cells, generous gutters, no frames or text. Hand-painted realistic ivory, aged brass, leather, steel and restrained jewel colors. Crisp bold silhouettes and strong value separation at 64px, not pixel art. Upper-left light and subtle material wear. Row-major subjects: 1 open leather journal with ivory blank pages and red ribbon; 2 three thick horizontal carved ivory menu bars held by small bronze end caps; 3 closed field guide with leather straps and feather quill; 4 pinned folded parchment quest note with red wax seal; 5 squat alchemy cauldron with teal liquid and a single curling steam wisp; 6 wolf-like horned monster head in profile for bestiary; 7 three upright old leather lore books; 8 crossed sword and breastplate for equipment; 9 crimson potion and small rolled scroll for consumables; 10 three-leaf green seedling and two seeds; 11 flat slate runestone with amber engraved rune; 12 ornate blue glass elixir bottle; 13 floating violet geometric spell sigil; 14 bread wedge and apple for food; 15 round iron bomb with fuse; 16 three steel throwing darts fanned out. Every object completely within its cell. No background, checkerboard, lettering, labels, borders or watermark. Original imagery.
prompts.parchment: Use case: stylized-concept. Original dark gothic RPG inventory icon, one unused Blank Parchment. A thick pale ivory rectangular sheet of vellum, both short ends curling loosely upward, faint natural fibers, clean unmarked center, irregular worn edges, slight diagonal tilt. Rich hand-painted material realism, crisp readable silhouette at 64 pixels, broad pale value contrasts with brown curled undersides. No writing, no runes, no seal, no quill, no additional objects, no frame, no ground shadow. True transparent background, single centered object fully contained with generous margins. Upper left soft light. Not pixel art, no logos or watermark.
prompts.elemental-cache: Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment prop atlas for Grimhollow, original painted dark-gothic top-down dungeon game. Exact THREE columns TWO rows, six centered isolated props with generous transparent gutters on true transparent alpha. Camera is consistent elevated three-quarter front top-down view, no ground planes, no frame or text, hard readable silhouettes, restrained worn brass, cool gray stone, iron, painterly realistic detail, not pixel art. Top row left to right: (1) unlit squat iron brazier on a low stone foot, filled with black coals, small bronze flame-shaped inset on front; (2) empty round stone fountain basin, cracked stone lip and a brass water-drop inset on front, clearly dry; (3) upright lightning conductor, a steel rod with three brass prongs, ceramic insulator and round grounded stone base, unpowered. Bottom row left to right: EXACT corresponding silhouettes and dimensions of top row (1) the same brazier lit with orange flame and warm coals; (2) the same fountain basin now filled with clear blue water; (3) the same lightning conductor holding two restrained blue-white electric arcs between its prongs. All six fit fully inside their equal cells, no overlapping effects between cells. No writing, scenery, characters, labels, checkerboard or watermark. Keep the shapes readable at 64px and each object foot centered at the same cell bottom anchor.
